policies.description: Any request to update an Incident SLA must include the mandatory field incident_sla_id.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: When updating an Incident SLA, the stage field must be set to one of the allowed enumeration values: in_progress, paused, completed, cancelled, or breached.

policies.policy_name: Pause SLA only on allowed on‑hold reasons
policies.description: The SLA timer may be set to stage = paused only when the related Incident is in stage = on_hold and its on_hold_reason is one of: Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem.
references: SLA Pause: The SLA timer must be paused (stage = paused) when the Incident is in stage = on_hold and the on_hold_reason is one of the following enumerations: Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem.

policies.description: If an Incident SLA is updated to stage = breached, the Incident’s escalation flag must be set to true and an automatic notification must be sent to the Manager.
references: Breach: If the SLA exceeds its duration (stage = breached), the escalation flag on the Incident must be set to true, and an automatic notification sent to the Manager.

policies.description: Each call to update_incident_sla_details must perform only one validated operation at a time; multiple field updates are not allowed unless using an approved batch endpoint.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.
